blurb: This check reads the machine type/model from prtconf and looks it up in a bundled IBM hardware-generation reference table to decide whether the LPAR hardware is still in active support. Hardware past its end-of-support date fails when the LPAR has physical I/O adapters of its own; a fully-virtual LPAR warns instead, because the hardware belongs to the host provider; an unknown machine type passes for manual verification on the IBM lifecycle pages.
